articles.title: ‘Series in India brings nothing to Windies’: Cricket’s revenue model sparks debate
articles.summary: Cricket West Indies CEO Chris Dehring criticised the bilateral revenue model, saying the board earns nothing when the team tours India, despite series potentially generating $20–30 million. He traced the problem to a 1997 ICC decision allowing hosts to retain broadcasting revenue.

Yash shares his excitement working with AR Rahman in 'Ramayana'
articles.summary: At a recent event, Yash, the actor portraying Ravana, shared his enthusiasm for collaborating with renowned composer AR Rahman. Reflecting on his childhood memories of dancing to Rahman's melodies, Yash believes this partnership adds a unique touch to the upcoming film 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend.' Additionally, the involvement of iconic composer Hans Zimmer showcases a fusion of musical styles aimed at presenting India's rich culture to a global audience..

articles.title: Beyoncé’s daughters spotted alongside her on stage for an inauguration event
articles.summary: Beyoncé made a stylish appearance at the Knowles-Rowland House inauguration with her daughters, Blue Ivy and Rumi. The sisters, joining fellow artist Kelly Rowland, stole the show as Blue Ivy proudly held scissors for the ribbon-cutting ceremony in a chic green jersey top.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' advance booking crosses USD 100K in US
articles.summary: Advance bookings for 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' have commenced and surpassed USD 100,000 in ticket sales. The film is set to release worldwide on November 5, with strong demand evident in the US market.
